name: bienenstich
title: Bienenstich (API)
documentation: BIENENSTICH — the API surface. Three public routes: content (the whole published site as JSON; ?body=0 for the light index, ?type=<type> to narrow), search (?q= needle over PUBLISHED markdown only), status (heartbeat). All sit behind the key gate: the secret lives in a bienenstich.key file beside the plugin — consumers present it as ?key=<secret>. Without a valid key every route answers exactly 'Bakery closed.' (HTTP 403, plain text) and nothing else — bots get no contract, no JSON, no crumbs. The key mint: open the 'Bienenstich key' entry in the admin drawer — with no key file it mints bs_<version>_<32 random chars> and writes it; a key already on disk is shown, never clobbered; ?rotate=1 mints fresh and instantly kills every consumer of the old key. Read-only by law: never writes, never leaks a draft. Setup: install → drawer → mint → copy the key → hand the ?key= URLs to your consumers. Until a key exists the API is closed — that is the safe default.
description: The CMS's API surface as a ware: one GET hands a headless consumer the whole published site as JSON — the site face plus every page with title, slug, url, tags and the rendered body (body=0 for the light index). Plus a public needle (search) and a heartbeat (status). Read-only by law: never writes, never leaks a draft, answers the same to every hand.
